description: This file defines the interface for IRDKWindowManager, an extension of Core::IUnknown, along with its nested notification interface. It includes method declarations for managing window display, app focus, visibility, input events, and notifications related to application state changes within the WPEFramework exchange namespace.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: An interface for managing windows and notifications in the RDK environment, providing functionalities like creating display windows, handling app focus/visibility, input interception, and notification registration.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager::INotification
classes.description: An internal notification interface to receive events such as user inactivity, app connection/disconnection, focus, visibility, and application lifecycle events.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback implementing INotification to receive window manager events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initialize the window manager plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitialize the plugin, releasing resources.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Create a display window with specified parameters in JSON string format.

methods.name: GetApps
methods.description: Retrieve a list of currently active application IDs.

methods.description: Register a key intercept for a specific key code and client.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Register multiple key intercepts in a single operation.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Remove a specific key intercept.

methods.name: AddKeyListener

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Reset the inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs

methods.name: EnableInputEvents

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configure key repeat behavior for input devices.

methods.name: SetFocus

methods.name: SetVisible
methods.description: Set visibility state for a specified client or application.

methods.name: RenderReady
methods.description: Check if the application's first frame has rendered.

methods.name: EnableDisplayRender
